items.title: Google Has Removed MV2 Extensions from the Chrome Web Store, Including UBO
items.summary: Google has officially removed Manifest V2 (MV2) extensions from the Chrome Web Store, impacting popular extensions like uBlock Origin. Developers should be aware of this shift as it pushes for the adoption of Manifest V3 (MV3), which changes how extensions operate and may affect their functionality.

items.title: I turned my security cameras into an automatic bird identification system
items.summary: A developer has transformed standard security cameras into a bird identification system using AI technology, showcasing innovative applications of machine learning in everyday devices. This project highlights the potential for AI to enhance surveillance technology beyond traditional security measures.

items.title: Apple caught off guard by AI demand for Mac Mini and Mac Studio
items.summary: Apple has experienced unexpected demand for its Mac Mini and Mac Studio products, driven largely by the growing interest in AI applications. This surge indicates a significant shift in consumer behavior and highlights the increasing importance of hardware in AI development.

items.title: ravynOS: Pre-alpha open-source OS based on Darwin, FreeBSD, Apple open-source
items.summary: ravynOS is a new open-source operating system that combines elements from Darwin and FreeBSD, aiming to provide a unique alternative to mainstream OS options. This project is significant for developers interested in contributing to or utilizing open-source software in innovative ways.

items.title: Launch HN: Almanac (YC S26) – AI that knows your company
items.summary: Almanac, a new AI tool launched in Y Combinator's Summer 2026 batch, aims to provide companies with tailored insights and knowledge management solutions. This tool represents a growing trend of AI applications designed to enhance organizational efficiency and decision-making.
